method.s: Line a 20 x 20 cm brownie tin with baking paper.
Melt butter and golden syrup in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Remove from the heat and add sugars, oats, coconut and flour. Mix together.
Separately, dissolve the baking soda in the water and add to the slice mixture.
Add the cranberries, apricots and walnuts. Mix well to combine.
Tip the mixture into the prepared tin and press down.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden brown. Remove from the oven and allow to cool in the tin.
Melt the chocolate chips and coconut oil together and drizzle over the cooled slice.
Cut into 16 pieces. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 10 days.
